bibliography.title: A Factorized Low-Rank RNN Framework for Uncovering Independent Neural Latent Dynamics and Connectivity

sections.title: 4.3. Mouse dorsal cortex voltage imaging data

page_map.layout_notes: Letter pages in a two-column layout. Figure 1, Figure 3, Figure 4, Figure 6, Figure 7 and Table 1 use wide or cross-column space; figure pages reduce continuous text area. No single-column main page.

abstract_sentences.text: Low-rank recurrent neural networks (lrRNNs) are a class of models that uncover low-dimensional latent dynamics underlying neural population activity.
Although their functional connectivity is low-rank, it lacks independence interpretations, making it difficult to assign distinct computational roles to different latent dimensions.

To address this, we propose the Factored Recurrent Neural Network (FacRNN), a generative lrRNN framework that assumes group-wise independence among latent dynamics while allowing flexible within-group entanglement.
These independent latent groups allow latent dynamics to evolve separately, but are internally rich for complex computation.
We reformulate the lrRNN under a variational autoencoder (VAE) framework, enabling us to introduce a partial correlation penalty that encourages independence between groups of latent dimensions.

Experiments on synthetic, monkey M1, and mouse voltage imaging data show that FacRNN consistently improves the disentanglement and interpretability of learned neural latent trajectories in low-dimensional space and low-rank connectivity over baseline lrRNNs that do not encourage group-wise independence.

claim_closure.claim: SVD/ICA/VAE independence structures are insufficient for the target latent groups.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 将低秩 RNN 的 latent 可逆变换不识别转成分组识别问题：VAE 重写提供接口，PC penalty 促进组间后验独立，W=ΣgWg 把 latent groups 映射到 sub-circuits；证据链见 p. 2–5 §§2–4（“partial correlation penalty”“sub-circuit connectivity”）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Eq. (4)–(12)、bdRNN 对照、PC、三种数据的核心设置、PC/latent alignment/TC/reconstruction、rank-1 失败、旋转检验和三项限制；p. 3–9 §§3–5。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Jordan 推导、β 曲线、全 latent 轨迹、排列复杂度、M1 β 表、全 connectivity heatmaps 和 Poisson 结果移入 p. 12–16 Appendix；这些证据分别由 A.1、A.3.1、A.3.2 调用。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 将 encoder/decoder、group latent 与 Wg 放在一张结构图；Figure 3(b) 将 rank 与 x/y 子连接并置；Figure 4(d–f) 将 brain maps、time series、reconstruction 和 connectivity 对齐，p. 4、7、8。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 真实数据缺少 latent ground truth 和 external inputs，G/H 需预设，非线性 encoder/decoder 不能直接给 W=AB；“general and powerful”因此是有限实验范围内的结论，p. 5、9、12。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 当 latent 存在可逆变换不识别时，同时报告结构性识别目标、任务变量对齐、sub-connectivity 分解和容量/分组消融；reconstruction alone 不足以支持解释性主张。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合低秩动力学且可测量 group-level structure 的时序数据；若目标是非线性 decoder 的直接 connectivity 或无可验证 G/H 先验的因果识别，应把结论限定为表示分解和诊断。
